messages:
Alex: Morning — async standup (short).
Alex: Yesterday: ran the spot-eviction drill on prewarm pools, validated bake + canary flow, landed autoscaler tweak (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4521).
Alex: Blocker: ap-southeast-1 quota looks low — 6 pods stuck Pending due to GPU quota. Raised ticket with cloud but need an interim plan.
Alex: Today: follow up quota escalation, spin a temporary canary in eu-west-1, and roll the autoscaler change to 10% canary.

Sam: Acked. I saw the Pending pods — attaching pod events snippet.
Sam: ```
Events:
  Type     Reason     Age    From               Message
  ----     ------     ---    ----               -------
  Warning  FailedCreate  2m   spot-provisioner   Insufficient gpu quota in ap-southeast-1
  Normal   Scheduled    1m   default-scheduler   Successfully assigned ...
```

Maria: @Alex @Sam — we can temporarily drain a few prewarm nodes in ap-southeast-1 and move workloads to eu-west-1 if you want. I can script the drain + label move.
Maria: Just flagging that moving KV cache warms will add ~50ms tail latency for ~15m.

Ravi: Pinged cloud team (ticket CLOUD-1187). They replied they can bump quota in 3–4 hours if we provide exact resource IDs. I pasted the node pool ids in the ticket.
Ravi: Also saw an odd spike in token cost yesterday around 03:20 UTC — correlating with a burst of long sequences from a beta customer. Not related to quota but thought to mention.

Ops-Oncall: DeployBot ran prewarm canary at 10:05 UTC — status: success. No rollbacks. Logs show ~2% increased CPU during warmup.

Sam: For temporary mitigation, propose: 1) scale down non-prod pods in ap-southeast-1 by 20%, 2) reroute canary to eu-west-1, 3) add a soft limit admission in the scheduler to prefer AZs with headroom.

Alex: Agreed. @Maria can you own the scale down script? @Ravi can you follow up CLOUD-1187 and post the ETA here? I'll trigger the canary reroute after Maria posts the script.

Maria: On it. Pushing a small script to infra/ops repo in a minute. Will post run command here.

Ravi: Cloud updated ticket: tentative bump at 16:40 UTC. I'll update if they confirm earlier.

Sam: Also opened a lightweight alert to warn if Pending pods > 3 in any region for >5m (alert ID: INFRA-867). Helps catch regressions.

Alex: Nice. No other blockers from me. Thanks team — will follow up after canary. :thumbsup:

DeployBot: [deploy] canary autopilot started (job id: canary-2026-03-17-118). Logs: https://logs.redwood/streams/canary-2026-03-17-118

Maria: Script ready: `./ops/drain-and-move.sh --region ap-southeast-1 --pct 20 --dry-run`
Maria: Will run dry-run first, then execute if Alex gives thumbs up.

Alex: Go for dry-run now. I’ll watch logs.

Sam: Dry-run looks clean. No unwanted evictions. Ready for real run on Alex + Ops-Oncall go-ahead.

Ops-Oncall: Give the go. Running real scale down now.

Maria: Real run complete — moved ~18% non-prod pods, prewarm pool headroom increased by 8 GPUs.
Maria: Confirming Pending pods dropped to 0 in ap-southeast-1.

Alex: Excellent. Thanks everyone. When CLOUD-1187 lands, we can revert the temporary moves and re-balance. I'll add a postmortem note in the weekly ops doc.

Ravi: Will update ticket and ping when done.

Sam: Closing this async thread — will follow up in the capacity channel if anything else pops.
